name: quality-glass-platform
description: Two Cloudflare Pages preview sites and a read-only Cloudflare Worker API foundation.

scripts.build: npm run build:shop && npm run build:manager
scripts.deploy:shop: npm run build:shop && node_modules/node/bin/node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js pages deploy apps/shop/dist --project-name=quality-glass-shop
scripts.deploy:manager: npm run build:manager && node_modules/node/bin/node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js pages deploy apps/manager/dist --project-name=quality-glass-manager-preview
scripts.db:migrate:local: node_modules/node/bin/node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js d1 migrations apply quality-glass-data-dev --local --config apps/api/wrangler.jsonc
